name: data-semantic-monorepo
description: Monorepo for data-semantic protocol, runtime, and compiler.

scripts.build: npm run build -w runtime && npm run build -w compiler
scripts.test: npm test -w runtime && npm test -w compiler
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w runtime && npm run lint -w compiler
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w runtime && npm run typecheck -w compiler
scripts.publish: echo ">> 同时发布 runtime 和 compiler <<" && npm run publish:runtime && npm run publish:compiler
